6824.title: Git state lost during worktree removal
6824.rootCauseOneLine: Forced worktree removal does not check worktree-private refs or unfinished Git operation metadata before deleting the administrative directory.
6824.proposedFix: Refuse removal under existing checkout and metadata locks when private refs or operation metadata exist; allow retry once resolved.
6824.caveats: Same-agent reproduction in two clean trusted checkouts; nonvisual host-entry harness, not a live UI; no external-writer atomicity guarantee.
